text: Six-week trial of 48 older adults: daily walks cut blood pressure about 3 points in non-medicated people.
Coffee's memory benefit was only tested in mice, at a dose like eight cups daily.
Home-working call-centre volunteers in China gained 13 percent productivity, mostly by taking fewer breaks.
The new bridge saves northside drivers about four minutes on average, measured during school holidays.
Mixed-quality trials suggest vitamin D prevents colds only in deficient people: one fewer cold per 30 yearly.
A four-week reading app test improved children's letter recognition but not story comprehension.
In lab tests, a pesticide at ten times field doses shortened bee foraging trips but did not kill colonies.
A volunteer-firm four-day week trial with no comparison group cut weekly hours from 38 to 34.
